Yes, this empty-pile behavior feels right. When I clicked over to **Done 0**, I didn't get a blank void — it told me "Nothing in Done yet," explained that bookmarks I finish will collect there, and reassured me my To read links are unchanged. That last bit matters: an empty tab could make me wonder for a second whether something got lost, and this answers that worry directly. The **View To read** button took me straight back and all three were still sitting there.

All three of the things you set out to do are there:

- It explains what will show up in that tab, so an empty Done reads as "you haven't finished anything yet," not "something's broken."
- It reassures me the To read collection is untouched.
- And the "Done 0" count stays visible on the tab, which is honest — zero is a real number, and seeing it is fine.

So this one's good.
